newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH NCM ALTERS INSURANCE POLICY RISK PROFILE.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH NCM ALTERS INSURANCE POLICY RISK PROFILE.

text.p: Dutch credit insurer NCM NV said on Tuesday it was changing its insurance policy on export credits of capital goods and international construction works.
The company said it was altering its policy by setting a risk-limit per country instead of setting overall transaction limits for those insurance risks.
NCM said the new policy would set fewer limits for big insurance transactions, while the portfolio remained sound.
"An insurance limit per country is not a statistical figure," NCM said, adding that it would also take into account the character, weight and size of each risk.

NCM is the holding company for a number of operating companies forming the NCM Groep, among which are Nederlandsche Credietverzekering Maatschappij NV (NCM-NL), NCM Credit Insurance Ltd (NCM-UK) and NCM International (NCM-INT).
